files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Tiles of different sizes in one grid: the large and wide tiles hold the important features. Sizes come from
  the data (large, wide, small). Axes: layout (bento, even: all tiles alike), media (none, image: a picture in
  the large tiles), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Tile } from "./bento-grid.types";

  export type BentoGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    tiles: Tile[];
    empty?: string;
    layout?: "bento" | "even";
    media?: "none" | "image";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Card from "../compose/Card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { at, cn } from "../utils";

  const SPAN: Record<string, string> = {
    "large": "md:col-span-2 md:row-span-2",
    "wide": "md:col-span-2",
    "small": "",
  };
  let {
    id,
    title,
    tiles,
    empty = "",
    layout = "bento",
    media = "none",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: BentoGridProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((tiles?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="layout-dashboard" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Grid cols="1-4" class="auto-rows-fr gap-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each tiles as tile (tile.id)}
        <Card
          variant="default"
          class={cn(
            "h-full overflow-hidden",
            (((density as string) === "compact") ? "gap-4 p-4" : ""),
            (((layout as string) === "bento") ? at(SPAN, tile.size) : "")
          )}
          data-testid="item"
          data-size={(((layout as string) === "bento") ? tile.size : "even")}
        >
          <CardContent class="flex h-full flex-col gap-4">
            <LucideIcon name={tile.icon} size={24} />
            <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
              {tile.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tile.text}
            </Text>
            {#if (((media as string) === "image") && ((tile.size === "large") || ((layout as string) === "even")))}
              <MediaFrame alt={tile.title} ratio="4/3" class="mt-auto" />
            {/if}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
